## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; leadership concentrated and narrow (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Top performers are Technology). Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech/Healthcare/Materials positive vs 8 sectors negative) and major short-vs-month divergences across large caps, so no clear directional bias.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology lead: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare second: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL. Materials third: sector positive on 1W but leadership mixed; key large caps showing modest strength (sector: 1W: +0.71% | 1M: -6.22%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) TREND EXHAUSTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) TREND EXHAUSTION; Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND; Real Estate weak: CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION, PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) TREND EXHAUSTION — weakness concentrated in Utilities/Energy/Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W momentum: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence — multiple large caps (e.g., SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL) show 1W vs 1M mismatch.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech shows concentrated leadership in semis and select platforms: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, while ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND highlight mixed internals; sector: 1W: +3.08% | 1M: +5.64% (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing dispersion and overall weakness: JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sector: 1W: -1.08% | 1M: -5.56% (20 stocks).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare steady-to-constructive on headlines: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — sector: 1W: +1.60% | 1M: -2.39% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to leading semiconductors and platform names showing confirmed momentum (QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND) and maintain Healthcare exposure into LLY/PFE themes; reduce exposure to structurally weak names in Utilities/Real Estate/underperforming Financials (NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broad divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +5.64%) and Healthcare (1W: +1.60% | 1M: -2.39%) given headline-driven flows. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +1.13%) and Utilities (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -6.85%) on recent weakness and trend exhaustion in majors.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch QCOM follow-through above last week’s highs to extend ABOVE TREND; INTC needs continued weekly follow-through to confirm momentum; ORCL breaking below this week’s lows would confirm BELOW TREND continuation; SHOP/AMGN failure to hold 1W gains would signal reversal risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+85): LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL on two FDA approvals and alliance — short-term news aligns with 1W lift. QCOM (+60): QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (license renewal with AAPL) confirms price accumulation. LRCX (+55): LRCX (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND — upbeat outlook confirmed by price. WBD (+80): WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — deal financing news confirms the rally.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-60): ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines and price decline are confirming. CCI (-60): CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND — dividend cut headlines align with the selloff. INTU (-55): INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND — negative analyst/operational headwinds confirmed by steep price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broad divergences. QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across multiple large caps (SHOP, AMGN, MA) and headline-driven moves (LLY, WBD) could flip internals quickly — monitor news confirmation.
